check: Rita has completed 50 + 9 + 121 = 180 hours, leaving 1,500 − 180 = 1,320 hours. At 220 hours per month, she needs 1,320 / 220 = 6 months.
error_description: The solution multiplies the monthly rate by 12, then incorrectly treats the resulting annual total of 2,640 hours as a monthly rate. This produces 0.5 months instead of 6 months.
